NovaListen uses these open-source libraries, without modifying their source:

AndroidX / Jetpack Compose / Material 3 — The Android Open Source Project — Apache 2.0.
AndroidX Media3 / ExoPlayer — The Android Open Source Project — Apache 2.0.
Kotlin — JetBrains s.r.o. and contributors — Apache 2.0.
Kotlin coroutines — JetBrains s.r.o. and contributors — Apache 2.0.
Coil — Coil Contributors — Apache 2.0.
Guava — The Guava Authors — Apache 2.0.

Upstream licence texts are included in this folder. Font-specific licences,
copyright notices and exact provenance are included in ../font-licenses/.
The APK is a debug build; the exhaustive transitive dependency inventory remains
to be automated before a production distribution.
